column3: “at twilight” renders “between the evenings” (also in verses 5 and 11), and “ordinances” renders “judgments” (also in verse 14).
“the dead person” renders “the soul (nefesh) of a man (adam)” (also in verse 7).
“any one of you” renders “a man, a man,” and “a dead person” renders “a soul (nefesh)”; NASB supplies “however.”
NASB supplies “by day,” which is not in the Hebrew.
“At the command of the LORD” renders “at the mouth of the LORD” (throughout verses 18–23).
“lingered” renders “made long,” and “the Lord’s charge” renders “the duty (mishmeret) of the LORD” (also in verse 23).
“a year” renders “days (yamim),” which can mean a year.
